hero.title: Organize your gift exchanges without the hassle.
hero.description: Create an exchange in minutes, share participant links, and let Kado handle the draw rules.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.description: The code is public. You can inspect it, use it, modify it, or host it yourself.

privacy.title: Privacy respected
privacy.description: No account is required to participate. Each person simply receives their participant link.

noMonetization.title: No intrusive monetization
noMonetization.description: No ads, no data resale, and no tracking cookies.

support.title: Kado is free and will stay that way.
support.subtext: If Kado has been useful to you, a small contribution towards hosting and development is always appreciated.

review.keepOrganizer: Bookmark this page and keep your password. No emails or password recovery are provided.

review.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. Uppercase and lowercase letters are equivalent.
review.requiredNames: The exchange name and your name are required (maximum 150 characters).
review.datesHelp: Optional dates. The planned draw date does not start the draw automatically. The exchange is archived 31 days after the gift exchange date.
review.imageHint: Click or drop an image. JPEG, PNG or WebP. Uploaded when you save.
review.reorderHelp: On the handle, use the up and down arrow keys to move the suggestion.
review.saveHelp: Saves your profile and all suggestions.
review.invalidHelp: Complete the required fields and correct errors before saving.
review.deleteHelp: This deletes the exchange and its access links. To confirm, type “{name}” exactly.
review.exclusionsHelp: Add and Delete save exclusions immediately. The Save button only saves the profile and suggestions.
review.confirmDeleteSuggestion: Delete this gift suggestion? This change will take effect when you save.
